title: DAAD Study Scholarships for Graduates (Master's)
description: Scholarships for international graduates of all disciplines to complete a full master's degree at a German state or state-recognised university, or a limited number of non-consecutive courses.
amount: EUR 992 per month plus payments towards health insurance, travel and, in many cases, tuition and rent subsidies

title: DAAD Research Grants - Doctoral Programmes in Germany
description: Grants supporting international doctoral candidates undertaking a full doctorate or a period of doctoral research in Germany, either in an individual supervision model or a structured programme.
amount: EUR 1,300 per month plus health insurance, travel and research allowances

title: DAAD EPOS - Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
field: Development-related fields (governance, economics, engineering, agriculture, health, environment)
description: Scholarships for professionals from developing countries with at least two years of relevant work experience to complete a postgraduate degree in a development-related subject at a selected German university.
amount: Full living stipend, health insurance, travel, study and research allowances

title: Deutschlandstipendium
provider: German Federal Government and private sponsors (via participating universities)
description: Merit-based scholarship for high-achieving and committed students at participating German universities, awarded regardless of nationality or the income of the student or their parents. Applications are made directly to the university.
amount: EUR 300 per month (half federal, half private sponsor) for at least two semesters

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Germany-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes delivered by a consortium of universities in at least three countries, many coordinated by or including German universities. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)

title: Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung Scholarships for International Students
description: Scholarships from the political foundation affiliated with Germany's Christian Democratic Union for international students and doctoral candidates already studying in Germany who show strong academic performance and civic engagement.
amount: Monthly stipend plus study, research and family allowances, and a seminar programme

title: Heinrich Boll Foundation Scholarships
description: Scholarships for undergraduate, master's and doctoral students of all nationalities enrolled at a state or state-recognised university in Germany, with an emphasis on academic excellence, social and political engagement and alignment with the foundation's values of ecology, democracy and human rights.
amount: Monthly stipend (up to EUR 934 for master's, EUR 1,300 for doctoral) plus allowances

title: Friedrich Ebert Stiftung Scholarships for International Students
description: Scholarships from the foundation associated with Germany's Social Democratic Party for international master's and doctoral students at German universities who demonstrate academic ability and commitment to social justice and democracy.
amount: Monthly stipend plus study and, where applicable, family allowances

title: Friedrich Naumann Foundation Scholarships
description: Scholarships from the liberal political foundation for gifted international students and doctoral candidates at German universities who share a commitment to liberal values, individual freedom and civic responsibility.
amount: Monthly stipend plus study allowance and seminar programme
